The petitioner has challenged the prosecution launched against him in C.C.No.7331/2018 pending trial before the II Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bengaluru Rural, Bengaluru for an offence punishable under Section 498A of IPC.
2.

entities.text: II Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bengaluru Rural, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The notice of this petition was served on the respondent No.2 but she has not appeared.
The learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the respondent No.2 is residing at Canada and that she is not interested to pursue the case.
This Court therefore directed the officer in-charge of Varthur police station to secure information from respondent No.2 3.
Mr. Prakash, Inspector of Police, Varthur Police Station, Bengaluru, is present before the Court.

He submits that he established contact with the respondent No.2, who NC: 2023:KHC:40650 disclosed that she is not interested to defend this criminal petition and that she is not interested to pursue the prosecution of the petitioner.
4. In that view of the matter, this petition is allowed.

The impugned prosecution of the petitioner in C.C.No.7331/2018 pending trial before the II Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bengaluru Rural,
Bengaluru for the offence punishable under Section 498A of IPC is quashed.
